method: Full partition parsed file-by-file by aggregate integrity checker; raw rows and filenames were not exported.
label_semantics: Challenge SepsisLabel used as supplied; do not shift again.
privacy: Aggregate only; no filenames, patient identifiers, rows, or predictions exported.
limitations: Integrity audit only; it is not a model evaluation or clinical validation.
Patient-positive counts refer to files with at least one positive challenge-label row, not confirmed clinical sepsis cases.
No byte-level file hashes were retained in this public report.
